blocks.text: Go Hotels Airport Road marked its 10th anniversary with a special thanksgiving celebration, bringing together its team members and guests for a meaningful occasion of gratitude, reflection, and togetherness. A thanksgiving Mass was held at the property, where staff and guests gathered to give thanks for the hotel’s 10-year journey. The presence of guests during the celebration made the occasion even more meaningful, reflecting the continued trust and patronage that have been an important part of Go Hotels Airport Road’s story.
